verdict.recommended_cta_structure: Clear, single-word ManyChat DM trigger tied to an explicit guide or workflow: 'Comment [TOOL] and I’ll DM you the direct template and setup guide.'
avoid_these: Vague philosophical mindset rants without tactical application (Script 2 & 3 style)
Generic 'I am Jack of all trades / don't know what to post' diary entries
Leaving caption section completely empty without keyword indexing or SEO context
